h1: Store updates without breaking the site
overview: Updates fix security problems and add features, but a careless update can break a theme or a checkout. We list what is out of date in your store, make a backup, test the updates on a copy of your theme where your platform allows, and then apply them to the live store. We check the home page, product pages, cart and checkout afterward. You receive a short log of what changed and anything that needs your decision.

faq: Will an update change how my store looks?
Not on purpose. We update on a test copy first where possible and compare it with your live store. If something looks different, we fix it or tell you before going live.
Shopify themes and apps, WooCommerce and WordPress plugins, BigCommerce themes and similar. Hosted platforms update their own core, so we focus on your theme and apps.
What if an update breaks something?
We take a backup first and test afterward. If something fails, we roll back or repair it in the same order, and we tell you what happened.
Will you update apps that I have customized?
We ask first. Heavily customized themes and apps can lose changes when updated, so we note what is custom and plan around it.
